messages:
zoe: hey folks :wave: i'm on week 1 and trying to run a quick GPU inference test in project redwood-playground-eu (europe-west1) but hit a quota error when adding an accelerator. also my AWS sandbox assume-role fails. who should i ping to link billing / bump GPU quota and to check the AWS trust?

ben: welcome zoe! quick checklist: 1) confirm project is linked to a billing account 2) request GPU quota for the region 3) check compute instance IAM/service-account scopes. can you paste the exact commands + error messages?

zoe: thanks. gcloud command i ran:
```
gcloud compute instances create gpu-test --project=redwood-playground-eu --zone=europe-west1-b --machine-type=n1-standard-8 --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1
```
console message: "Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for region europe-west1."
aws command i tried:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/Redwood-Onboarding --role-session-name zoe-test
```
and the aws CLI returned: "An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRole operation: Invalid principal in policy."

olivia: hi zoe! people-ops sent the billing invite on day 0 but it sometimes lands in promotions/spam. i'll re-send now. if you don't get it, reply here and i'll manually attach the billing link.

cloud-ops: for the GPU quota, we need the project + region + accelerator type. we can fast-track for new hire test runs. recommended request: add 2 T4 GPUs to europe-west1, priority=medium, requestor=zoe. if it's urgent set priority=high. to link billing yourself you can run: `gcloud beta billing projects link redwood-playground-eu --billing-account=0000-1111-2222` (people-ops will confirm billing-account id).

ben: also double-check that the service account you're using has `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1` and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on the project. missing SA permissions often block instance creation even after quota is raised.

infra-setup-bot: ticket created: INF-8529. Action: add 2 x GPU (nvidia-tesla-t4) to project redwood-playground-eu in europe-west1. ETA 6 hours. To attach billing manually, follow https://redwood.internal/infra/billing-link and include project-id + billing-account-id. For AWS assume-role error: inspect the target account's trust policy for the role ARN; common cause: outdated principal or missing onboarding-account ARN. If you want, paste the role arn and we'll validate trust doc.

zoe: thanks everyone. i accepted the billing invite (found in spam) and pasted the role arn to cloud-ops in a DM. i also confirmed my SA roles are missing `serviceAccountUser` so i'll request that from my manager. i'll wait on INF-8529 then retry the instance creation. appreciate the fast responses :relieved:

cloud-ops: sounds good. if INF-8529 ETA slips ping @ben and i'll escalate. alternatively, you can run a quick hosted GPU test in `redwood-hosted-sandbox` until quota is live. post results here once you re-run. :rocket:
